journey.name: onchain send activity confirmation
journey.description: Verifies that one accepted Savings payment keeps one activity entry through wallet sync, confirmation and restart, with the selected contact and fee preserved. Preconditions: two owned regtest wallets linked as contacts, a synced sending wallet with at least 6,000 confirmed sats, and access to the configured regtest backend's block-mining helper. Keep both apps running.

actions.action: On the receiving wallet, create a fresh 5,000-sat payment request for the sending contact with Savings as its only accepted payment method
On the sending wallet, open the received payment request and tap Pay
Verify the review shows 5,000 sats, Savings and the receiving contact; record the fee
Swipe the send handle fully to the right and wait for Bitcoin Sent
Open Details, then Explore, and record the exact transaction ID
Return to the sending wallet's activity list and verify exactly one outgoing entry has that transaction ID and receiving contact
Mine one regtest block using the configured fixture backend and wait for the recorded transaction to confirm
Open the outgoing activity and verify its status is Confirmed, its transaction ID is unchanged, and it preserves the contact, 5,000-sat recipient amount and recorded fee
Return to the activity list and verify no second entry exists for that transaction ID
Restart the sending app normally, open its activity list, and verify the same single confirmed payment and contact remain
